entries.title: Amos 6:1
segments: ¶Woe to you [who are] at ease in Zion, And trust in Mount Samaria, Notable persons in the chief nation, To whom the house of Israel comes!

entries.title: Amos 6:2
segments: Go over to Calneh and see; And from there go to Hamath the great; Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. [Are you] better than these kingdoms? Or is their territory greater than your territory?

entries.title: Amos 6:3
segments: [Woe to] you who put far off the day of doom, Who cause the seat of violence to come near;

entries.title: Amos 6:4
segments: Who lie on beds of ivory, Stretch out on your couches, Eat lambs from the flock And calves from the midst of the stall;

entries.title: Amos 6:5
segments: Who sing idly to the sound of stringed instruments, [And] invent for yourselves musical instruments like David;

entries.title: Amos 6:6
segments: Who drink wine from bowls, And anoint yourselves with the best ointments, But are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

entries.title: Amos 6:7
segments: Therefore they shall now go captive as the first of the captives, And those who recline at banquets shall be removed.

entries.title: Amos 6:8
segments: ¶The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself, The LORD God of hosts says: "I abhor the pride of Jacob, And hate his palaces; Therefore I will deliver up [the] city And all that is in it."

entries.title: Amos 6:9
segments: Then it shall come to pass, that if ten men remain in one house, they shall die.

entries.title: Amos 6:10
segments: And when a relative [of the dead], with one who will burn [the bodies], picks up the bodies to take them out of the house, he will say to one inside the house, "[Are there]  any more with you?" Then someone will say, "None." And he will say, "Hold your tongue! For we dare not mention the name of the LORD."

entries.title: Amos 6:11
segments: For behold, the LORD gives a command: He will break the great house into bits, And the little house into pieces.

entries.title: Amos 6:12
segments: Do horses run on rocks? Does [one] plow [there] with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into gall, And the fruit of righteousness into wormwood,

entries.title: Amos 6:13
segments: You who rejoice over Lo Debar, Who say, "Have we not taken Karnaim for ourselves By our own strength?"

entries.title: Amos 6:14
segments: "But, behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel," Says the LORD God of hosts; "And they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath To the Valley of the Arabah."
